participation.context: Captured the street-post playbill on his walk north up Bishopsgate to the Theatre.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You saved a view of the Bishopsgate playbill tacked to a street post on your way to play The Knave at two.

title: Saved a view of the Bishopsgate playbill for The Knave

description: The Knave, no name of a part

participation.context: Played, and brought no part-name away.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You read the title and the hour. You did not give the side a name.

title: Played the Knave

description: Lord Mayor and Aldermen's petition to the Privy Council

participation.context: Read and filed the Guildhall copyist's digest at the Theatre after playing The Knave.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You imported the copyist's digest of the City's 13 September petition after the afternoon play, noting that no Council order has come down and the company awaits word from the Lord Chamberlain.

title: Imported the copyist's digest of the Lord Mayor's petition
